cost_scope: Usage at highest documented token rates; not a provider invoice. Uncertain outcomes keep the full reservation.
quality_scope: Explicitly selected fixed synthetic positive cases only; failure scenarios remain offline; not full-suite, human-reviewed correctness or production acceptance.

diagnostic_scope.confirmed: The formal executor claimed the reviewed two-case plan, loaded the designated credential, attempted the first case and stopped on output_contract before returning a verified selection.
diagnostic_scope.not_recorded: Specific output-contract subtype, raw model response, exception text and trusted usage for this failed request were not retained.
diagnostic_scope.limits: Cannot distinguish malformed envelope/content, incomplete finish, schema, facts, citations or recommendation checks. Does not diagnose the first-round failure.
diagnostic_scope.next_step: Offline refinement of fixed, non-sensitive contract failure codes; no automatic online retry, budget release or relaxed validation.

budget_reconciliation.scope: Conservative local reservations, not provider spending. Unknown first/third-round usage is not treated as free.
